(Japanese: '''セミファイナル！決勝へ進むのは！？''' ''The Semi-Finals! Who is Heading to the Finals!?'') is the 176th episode of ''[[Pokémon the Series: Diamond and Pearl]]'', and the 642nd episode of the [[Pokémon animated series]]. It first aired in Japan on May 13, 2010 and in the United States on October 2, 2010. {{spoilers}} ==Blurb== Coming down to the wire at the Pokémon Contest Grand Festival, our four semifinalists are Nando, Zoey, Jessilina, and Dawn. First up is Zoey versus Nando, and both Coordinators and their Pokémon put on a spectacular performance. As Zoey begins to take control by using Nando's attacks against him, the five-minute time limit expires, leaving Zoey as the victor! Next up, it's Dawn versus Jessilina. It becomes clear early on that Dawn has grown a lot as a Coordinator since her journey began. She is decisive, determined, and confident, and her crisp commands propel her Buneary and Cyndaquil to new heights! And when the time runs out, much to Jessilina's dismay, Dawn is declared the winner! So it's Dawn and Zoey in the finals, just as they hoped... And next time, the girls will face off for the title of Top Coordinator! ==Plot== The [[Sinnoh Grand Festival]] continues with [[Jessie|Jessilina]]'s victory in the third round of the Battle Stage with {{TP|James|Mime Jr.}} and {{TP|James|Carnivine}}. Because of a comment by [[Fantina]], Jessilina suggests that they should forget about the rest of the [[Grand Festival]] and crown her as [[Top Coordinator]] already, to which Fantina replies that Jessilina will just have to win the tournament herself. The match-ups for the semifinals are then revealed with {{an|Dawn}} facing Jessilina and [[Zoey]] versus [[Nando]]. That night, Dawn and her {{TP|Dawn|Piplup}} take a moment to clear their heads on the balcony. Luckily {{Ash}} and {{an|Brock}} give her a confidence boost. The group then hears the music of a harp and goes downstairs to investigate, where they find Nando playing for dozens of [[wild Pokémon]] in the forest. Noticing them, Nando pauses his rendition and reveals that he is feeling nervous having made it so far in the Grand Festival. Zoey soon joins them and promises Nando a good battle. Since everyone is out, Brock wonders what Jessilina is doing and it is shown that [[Jessie]] are in a warehouse with [[James]] and {{MTR}}. Before them are piles of boxes containing Jessilina's memorabilia. While James and Meowth are sure that the memorabilia will earn them lots of money, Jessie daydreams about the rich lifestyle she will earn when she becomes Top Coordinator. The next day, the semifinals officially begin and it's Zoey versus Nando first. Zoey sends out her {{p|Mismagius}} and {{p|Leafeon}} while Nando calls out his {{TP|Nando|Kricketune}} and new {{DL|Nando|Lopunny}}. Mismagius and Leafeon come out in a shower of [[Sticker|Star Seals]] while Kricketune and Lopunny are released in a shower of Song Seals. Unfazed, Zoey tells Leafeon to use {{m|Energy Ball}} and Mismagius to use {{m|Shock Wave}}. The Shock Wave fuses with the Energy Ball to create an electrifying meteorite, and the [[Contest combination|combination]] costs Nando some early points. Nando has Lopunny use {{m|Jump Kick}} to knock Zoey's combination away while Kricketune uses {{m|Bug Buzz}} to immobilize Leafeon. Lopunny meanwhile dances around and wraps the streamers created by Bug Buzz around itself to create an elegant effect and also take away a portion of Zoey's points. Suddenly, the Energy fusion Ball that Lopunny had kicked away returns, shooting straight down. Kricketune then blasts away the fusion ball to create a shower of rainbow sparks, which is used to further emphasize Lopunny's elegance, costing Zoey even more points. Recovering, Zoey orders Leafeon and Mismagius to use {{m|Double Team}}, surrounding Nando's pair in alternating duplicates. The two Pokémon alternate between each other with their Double Teams as they surround Nando's Pokémon. Nando is amazed by the stunning contrast of the double Double Team. He orders Lopunny to use {{m|Blizzard}}, but he ends up losing points as the light from the disappearing doubles only makes Leafeon and Mismagius shine all the more. Nando tells Kricketune to use {{m|Sing}}. The music notes spiral around Kricketune and Lopunny in a swirling manner, which causes Zoey to drop to 1/2 of her total points. However, Zoey had been expecting Sing and told Mismagius to use {{m|Lucky Chant}}. Brock explains that Lucky Chant is a move that prevents [[critical hit]]s but is confused as to how it will counter Sing. The gems on Mismagius's body glow as Mismagius soars into the air. Purple tendrils then appear out of the gems and knock away the music notes created by Sing and Nando's points drop to 1/2 as a result. Leafeon follows on with a {{m|Leaf Blade}}, slashing through Lopunny's counter {{m|Focus Blast}}, and landing a hit on its opponent. Kricketune tries an {{m|X-Scissor}} against Leafeon, but Mismagius intercepts it with a {{m|Psywave}}. Startled, Nando has Lopunny leap in and carry Kricketune out of danger, causing Psywave to miss. Zoey tells Leafeon to use Leaf Blade again to take up the X-Scissor. Kricketune and Leafeon then collide several times with neither of them giving an inch. Both sides lose an eighth of their original point total. Dawn remarks in awe of Zoey and Nando's battles, stating that the clash between the two Coordinators and their Pokémon is one of the purest and most amazing forms of Contest battling she has ever witnessed. Brock smiles at her comments. Down to the thirty-second mark, both Zoey and Nando are still even, each with about 30% of their original score remaining. Nando orders Kricketune to use {{m|Silver Wind}} while Lopunny uses Blizzard by spinning around Kricketune. The Blizzard and the Silver Wind combine to form snowflakes that float gently down to the ground while Lopunny continues to show off its elegant dance moves. Zoey has Leafeon use {{m|Aerial Ace}} while Mismagius unleashes a Psywave. The resulting combination gives Leafeon beautiful bluish-white wings, and the leaf on Leafeon's head glows white in preparation for a blade attack. Fantina is left vocally awestruck by the combination, while Nando is equally amazed. Nando prepares his counter by having Lopunny intercept Leafeon. However, Mismagius intercepts with a Shock Wave. Lopunny's kick collides with Mismagius's shield of thunder and an explosion occurs that knocks both Pokémon back. Kricketune then uses X-Scissor to counter Leafeon's fusion. The two collide and orange sparks fly off. The orange sparks cause Leafeon's psychic wings to disappear while neither Kricketune nor Leafeon budge. The power level reaches an apex and an explosion occurs that leaves the stadium dark as bright sparkles fall to the ground. The lights are returned as Zoey and Nando grin at each other. Time is up, and though the difference in points is slim, Zoey wins the round and will be advancing to the finals. Nando congratulates Zoey on her win and wishes her good luck in the finals. Absolutely stunned by the beautiful performance, Fantina appears out of the blue and raises both Nando and Zoey's arms up in victory. Next up is Dawn against Jessilina. Dawn runs down the halls to enter the stadium but stops when she sees Zoey returning. Both grin at each other and Dawn tells Zoey to wait for her at the finals. While Jessilina blows heart-filled kisses to the crowd, Dawn takes a deep breath and tells herself that she just needs to believe in her Pokémon. [[Johanna]] anxiously watches from the [[television]] as battle starts and Dawn sends out her {{TP|Dawn|Buneary}} and her {{TP|Dawn|Cyndaquil}} in a shower of Star Seals. Jessilina meanwhile selects {{TP|Jessie|Seviper}} and Carnivine. They enter using their unique "Rocket Start" before Buneary counters with {{m|Dizzy Punch}} and Cyndaquil with a {{m|Smokescreen}}. Next, Buneary spins around as she uses {{m|Ice Beam}} to {{status|freeze}} Seviper solid and Cyndaquil knocks Carnivine over with a {{m|Flame Wheel}}. Cyndaquil then uses {{m|Swift}} while Buneary uses {{m|Bounce}} to spin around the golden stars. Carnivine retaliates with {{m|Vine Whip}} while Seviper prepares to lash Buneary with {{m|Poison Tail}}. However, Buneary jumps out of the way and, as a result, Seviper gets hit with the Swift attack. Carnivine then tries to get Buneary once more with Vine Whip but Buneary again bounces out of the way and sends Carnivine crashing into Seviper. Seviper quickly recovers and traps Cyndaquil in its {{m|Wrap}} attack while Cyndaquil's Swift collides with Carnivine. Dawn then uses another combination of Ice Beam and Swift while Jessilina counters with Seviper's {{m|Haze}} and Carnivine's {{m|Bullet Seed}} barrage. The battle soon ends as the time is called. Dawn is shown to lead by a huge amount of points, thus earning herself a place in the finals. Meanwhile, Jessilina realizes that her dreams of stardom and fame have been destroyed and approaches Dawn angrily. Everyone else is confused while James and Meowth are well-aware of Jessie's temper tantrums. However, Jessilina wasn't looking to pick a fight with Dawn. Instead, she pinches both of Dawn's cheeks and tells her to win the Grand Festival or else. She then walks off while Dawn thanks her. The following day arrives, and Marian welcomes everyone to the much-anticipated finals match. Lit by bright spotlights, Marian first introduces Zoey, hailing from [[Snowpoint City]], and then Dawn, from [[Twinleaf Town]]. The long-time rivals and friends stare at each other intently as the five-minute countdown begins, marking the start of their most important battle ever. ==Major events== [[File:Sinnoh Grand Festival
